mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at 42 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park. It is a New Moon tonight, and with an overnight low of 42 degrees, you can expect some rain to move in before morning.
Looking at our desk, there are no new city news articles or official emails to bring to your attention this evening.

If you are looking for plans, there is plenty happening. Today you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, we have live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza night at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Thursday also brings the start of ART House 360 nights.
Regarding the weekly police report, there were no incidents recorded for the current period.

Today's flavor of the day was Chocolate Heath Crunch. As the store is currently closed for the night, we look forward to tomorrow, November 12, when the doors will open at 10:00 AM serving up the Chocolate Caramel Twist.
